FAQ

Questions, answered

Are these calculators really free?

Yes. Every calculator is free with no sign-up. The site is supported by a few unobtrusive ads.

How accurate are the results?

Formulas are checked against manufacturer coverage specs and round up to whole units. Always confirm with the label on your product.

Do you add a waste factor?

Yes, where relevant (concrete, flooring, tile, pavers) you can set a waste percentage.
